title: Q1 Results 08th Aug Highlights: Delhivery, Anant Raj, Apollo Micro Systems, Akums Drugs Pharma, Aditya Birla Fashion, Ceigall India, PNC Infratech Oswal Pumps to announce Q1 results - The HinduBusines
text:
Q1 Results Today, 08th August 2026 Highlights: Find all the latest Q1 results 2026 updates of Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail, Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals, Anant Raj, Anmol India, Apollo Micro Systems, Delhivery, Eveready Industries India, Medi Assist Healthcare Services, Oswal Pumps, Studds Accessories, Sundaram Brake Linings, Suryalakshmi Cotton Mills, TVS Electronics, Unifinz Capital India, Vani Commercials, WEP Solutions, Windsor Machines, and Yash Innoventures and others

(PTI) Ceigall India Ltd on Saturday posted a 34.7 per cent year-on-year increase in its net profit at Rs 75.3 crore in the June quarter of FY27.

Its net profit stood at Rs 55.9 crore in the quarter ended June 2025, the company said in a statement.

Revenue from operations also increased to Rs 901.5 crore in the reporting quarter from Rs 818.3 crore in the same period a year ago.

Cupid, a leading consumer healthcare and FMCG company, has reported that its net profit in the June quarter was up nearly three times to ₹44 crore against ₹15 crore logged in the same period last year, on higher demand across business.

Cupid's Q1 net profit surges to ₹44 crore, fueled by robust demand and revenue growth to ₹155 crore.

Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Ltd (ABFRL) on Saturday reported widening of its consolidated net loss to ₹248.73 crore for June quarter FY27.

Total expenses of ABFRL, which owns Pantaloons and Style Up brands , along with a host of ethnic brands, were at ₹2,395.45 crore, up 11.5%

Battery and flashlight maker Eveready Industries India Ltd on Saturday reported a 22.3 per cent year-on-year increase in its consolidated net profit to ₹36.97 crore in the June quarter of FY27.

Eveready Industries reports a 22% profit increase to ₹37 crore and a revenue growth of 9% in Q1 FY27.

BEML narrows Q1 loss to ₹27 crore with total income rising to ₹821.19 crore, signaling strong growth potential.

Greenpanel Industries Limited on Saturday reported a net profit of ₹122.92 lakh for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, a turnaround from a net loss of ₹3,462.36 lakh in the corresponding quarter of the previous year.

Revenue from operations rose to ₹34,981.09 lakh in Q1 FY27, up from ₹32,819.35 lakh in Q1 FY26, reflecting an improvement in business volumes. Total income for the quarter stood at ₹35,241.85 lakh. Total expenses came in at ₹35,028.66 lakh, resulting in a profit before tax of ₹213.19 lakh, compared to a pre-tax loss of ₹4,739.50 lakh a year ago.

On a sequential basis, revenue declined from ₹39,892.90 lakh reported in Q4 FY26, though profit before tax improved from ₹105.65 lakh in the previous quarter. Earnings per share for the quarter stood at ₹0.10.

The company operates two segments. Medium density fibreboards (MDF) and allied products remained the dominant segment, contributing ₹31,664.02 lakh in revenue, while plywood and allied products contributed ₹3,317.07 lakh. The MDF segment reported a pre-tax segment result of ₹3,630 lakh, while plywood contributed ₹172.46 lakh.

In a separate development, the Board approved reclassification requests from eight members of the Promoter Group, including Rajesh Mittal, Karuna Mittal, Sanidhya Mittal, and related entities, who have sought to move to the Public Shareholder category. All eight entities currently hold nil equity shares.

Captain Polyplast Limited on Saturday reported standalone revenue from operations of ₹81.16 crore for the quarter ended 30 June 2026, up from ₹69.74 crore in the same quarter last year, a year-on-year increase of nearly 17 per cent. Total income for the quarter stood at ₹81.66 crore against ₹70.22 crore a year ago.

Net profit after tax on a standalone basis rose to ₹4.65 crore from ₹4.15 crore in Q1 FY26, a gain of roughly 12 per cent. Basic and diluted earnings per share came in at ₹0.78 for the quarter. Total comprehensive income for the period was ₹4.67 crore.

On a consolidated basis, which includes associate company Captain Pipes Limited, revenue from operations remained the same at ₹81.16 crore. Consolidated net profit after tax was ₹4.66 crore, with total comprehensive income at ₹4.68 crore.

The company operates two reportable business segments — manufacturing of micro irrigation systems and allied products, which is the dominant contributor, and a polymer distribution business as DCA cum CS of Indian Oil Corporation Ltd (IOCL). Segment 1 posted standalone results of ₹9.34 crore against total segment results of ₹9.10 crore for the quarter.

Advanced Enzyme Technologies Limited on Saturday announced a share buyback of up to ₹697 million at a board meeting held in Thane, alongside quarterly financial results and two subsidiary-related decisions.

The board approved the repurchase of up to 1,394,000 equity shares at a maximum price of ₹500 per share through the open market route on stock exchanges. The buyback represents 1.24 per cent of the company’s existing paid-up equity capital. Promoters and the promoter group will not participate in the buyback. A Buyback Committee has been constituted to execute the transaction, and a public announcement with timelines is expected to follow.

The board also approved acquiring the remaining 4.28 per cent stake in JC Biotech Private Limited (JCB) from existing shareholders at ₹90 per share, amounting to a total consideration of ₹79.79 million. JCB, which manufactures bio-pharmaceuticals through aerobic fermentation and reported a turnover of ₹728 million in FY2026, will become a wholly owned subsidiary upon completion of the deal, expected by September 30, 2026. Advanced Enzymes currently holds 95.72 per cent in JCB.

Additionally, the board approved infusion of up to ₹20 million into Advanced Nutrazyme Private Limited (ANPL), its wholly owned nutrition and wellness subsidiary, through equity investment or inter-corporate deposit in one or more tranches by December 31, 2027.
